title: Antigravity HFS: Memory-Resident Debian Kernel & Loopback Hole-Buffer Guard against Trailing Viruses
description: Release Version 1.0.0 of the HFS (Hole-buffer File System) autonomous architecture. Combines a memory-resident Debian 12/Linux 6.12+ kernel (toram), kernel RAM disk (/dev/ram0), loopback sparse container (hfs.img on /dev/loop0), and cryptographic SHA-256 hole-buffer and sector slack space hashing to detect and neutralize trailing viruses.
